# Udit Rawat & team

> AI automation for small businesses, from Toronto and New Delhi. We connect the tools a business already uses (Meta, Shopify, WhatsApp, QuickBooks, its documents), automate the repetitive work, and send a one-page report every week on what is working. Serving businesses in Canada and the US.

## What we do
- [Payback](https://uditrawat.dev/payback/): connects Meta ads, comments and messages to Shopify sales or bookings, and shows each week which ads make money.
- [Signed Off](https://uditrawat.dev/signed-off/): reads photos of signed paperwork, checks them against the job, and gets the invoice out the same day.
- [Clean File](https://uditrawat.dev/immigration/): cross-checks every name, date and number across a file before it is submitted.
- [Know How](https://uditrawat.dev/know-how/): answers staff questions from a company's own documents, citing the page each answer came from.
- Shopify stores with email and order automation.
- Custom automation, scoped and agreed before work starts.

## Shipped work
- [Misaanjh](https://uditrawat.dev/work/misaanjh/): live Shopify storefront with in-house email and Flow automation.
- [AdaMax](https://uditrawat.dev/work/adamax/): automated pipeline that turns a written script into narrated, animated infographic reels.
- [Tribunal](https://uditrawat.dev/work/tribunal/): multi-agent workflow with a deterministic quote verifier; 96% quote grounding on a 32-claim set.
- [muscle-memory](https://uditrawat.dev/work/muscle-memory/): automates software with no API; AI learns a task once, then it replays with no model in the loop.
- LLM cost: 85% lower running cost on one production pipeline at TapHealth (private codebase).
- On-device ML: a quantized model running fully offline on a budget Snapdragon phone.

## More
- [Lab](https://uditrawat.dev/lab/): research reproductions, retrieval experiments and developer tools.
